scenes.text: For twenty-six years straight, there hasn't been a single day without humans in space.
On November second, two thousand, three astronauts moved into the International Space Station.
Bill Shepherd, Yuri Gidzenko and Sergei Krikalev lived there for about four and a half months.
Since then, there has always been a crew on board, handing over to the next one.
Nearly three hundred people from twenty-six countries have visited.
The station circles Earth about sixteen times a day, so crews see around sixteen sunrises.
Would you live in space for six months?

title: Humans have lived in space nonstop for 26 years 🛰️
caption: On Nov 2, 2000, the first crew moved into the International Space Station, and someone has lived up there ever since. Nearly 300 people from 26 countries have visited. 🛰️
